description: This source file defines the ArtifactDispatcher class, which manages and dispatches operations related to artifacts such as saving, streaming, deleting, and retrieving paths in the context of the Playwright test automation framework. It implements the channels.ArtifactChannel interface and extends the Dispatcher class, handling Promise-based asynchronous file operations and stream management.

classes.name: ArtifactDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class that handles artifact-related operations such as saving, streaming, failure reporting, deletion, and path retrieval for artifacts within the Playwright framework.

methods.description: Saves the artifact to a specified path.

methods.name: stream

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the artifact and cleans up resources.
